thread:
maria: Quick sync: product wants a short migration pack for the v1 -> v2 sunset. Needed: 1) embed-dim checker CLI, 2) compact py + ts compat snippets, 3) 1-paragraph customer note. I opened a PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4950. Who can take which piece?

jon: I can build the embed checker CLI. Plan: `ri-embeds check --project <id>` returns JSON with index, expected_dim, observed_dim, and a recommendation line. Will include `--suggest` to print reindex/pin commands.

kevin: I'll do the Python snippets and a small rollback example handling 409 + `x-ri-deprecation`. Tiny snippet:```py
resp = client.invoke(...)
if resp.status_code == 409 or resp.headers.get('x-ri-deprecation'):
    legacy = LegacyClient(token=LEGACY_TOKEN)
    resp = legacy.invoke(...)
```

viv: I'll add TS compat helpers and a try/fallback quickstart. Short helper: `export const normalize = r => ({ model_id: r.model || r.model_id, input: r.prompt || r.input })`. Also note streaming framing change in a single sentence.

maria: Good. Marketing needs the customer paragraph. Draft: "In 30 days we will retire the v1 inference API. To avoid disruption, pin model versions or enable the recommended fallback policy. If you use embeddings, run our embed checker to detect dimension mismatches; support can assist with reindexing." Can marketing/legal tweak?

jon: CLI sample output (compact): `{"index":"users-v1","expected_dim":1536,"observed_dim":1024,"status":"mismatch","recommendation":"reindex or pin fallback"}`. Will make it machine-readable and also print a human summary.

kevin: I'll also add a small YAML runtime example for `fallback_models` and a README note in the SDKs about compat helpers. YAML:```yaml
fallback_models:
  - redwood-3b-quant
  - redwood-2b-compat
fallback_policy: failover
```

docs-bot: Reminder: PRs need a changelog entry, snippet smoke tests, and an owner label.

maria: Timeline: aim to have updates in PR by Wed EOD, merge Thu, staging Fri. Can everyone hit Wed EOD?

viv: yes :+1:

jon: yes, basic CLI tomorrow, tests by Wed EOD.

kevin: yes, will push snippets and tests today.

docs-bot: PR 4950 updated: owner added, smoke tests queued.

maria: Thanks — I'll move the PR to `ready-for-review` once snippets, changelog, and tests are in. If blockers pop up (runtime flag late, etc.), post here and we'll reassign. :rocket:
